rows.name: initial_risk_points
rows.formula: r = abs(reference intended entry price - original structural stop); r>0. Remains frozen at entry.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: htf_timeframe
rows.formula: Timeframe of the actual selected larger gap.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: parent_timeframe
rows.formula: Timeframe of the actual locked supporting gap.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: parent_width_r
rows.formula: Actual locked parent width in points / r.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: opposing_width_r
rows.formula: Actual selected opposing gap width in points / r.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: entry_gap_width_r
rows.formula: Width in points of the actually eligible fresh-continuation entry gap / r.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: opposing_parent_separation_r
rows.formula: Nonnegative edge-to-edge separation used by the effective engine distance test / r; zero for overlapping intervals. Use the same implemented formula, not distance to midpoint.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: entry_parent_midpoint_r
rows.formula: (Intended entry - actual locked parent midpoint) / r. Frozen structural entry feature.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: lock_to_entry_minutes
rows.formula: Elapsed UTC minutes from actual supporting-parent lock to entry-decision time.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: inversion_to_entry_minutes
rows.formula: Elapsed UTC minutes from inversion known-at time to entry-decision time.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: clock_sin
rows.formula: sin(2*pi*m/1440), m=local Chicago seconds since midnight /60 at THIS job decision.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: clock_cos
rows.formula: cos(2*pi*m/1440), same m; timezone/DST is explicit.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: minutes_to_mandatory_close
rows.formula: Nonnegative real elapsed UTC minutes to this session frozen mandatory flatten deadline; earlier shortened-session deadline used.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: trading_weekday
rows.formula: Weekday of the frozen session trading-date label, not calendar entry-date weekday.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: close_change_5_r
rows.formula: (C0-C5)/r from six contiguous finalized 1m closes within this session, all availability<=decision; C0 is latest known close.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: range_15_r
rows.formula: (max(H_i)-min(L_i))/r across latest 15 contiguous finalized 1m bars in this session, all availability<=decision.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: signed_efficiency_15
rows.formula: (C0-C15)/sum_{i=0..14}|C_i-C_{i+1}| from 16 contiguous finalized same-session closes. Zero if all changes zero.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: minutes_entry_to_target
rows.formula: Elapsed UTC minutes from actual entry fill to first qualifying 1R checkpoint.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: mae_so_far_r
rows.formula: max(0, entry - min(observed trade prices from entry event through checkpoint))/r for long; exact prints only through decision, not eventual trade MAE.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: checkpoint_overshoot_r
rows.formula: (Current observed triggering print - original 1R limit price)/r. Does not change the first five limit fills.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: implied_move_points
rows.formula: M=(eligible 1D Max-eligible 1D Min)/2 at THIS decision; endpoints finite and ordered, M>0.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: risk_to_implied_move
rows.formula: r / M; null if current M invalid.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: separation_to_implied_move
rows.formula: Actual selected opposing-parent separation in points / M; null if current M invalid.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: price_in_implied_range
rows.formula: (Current reference decision price-eligible 1D Min)/(2*M); not clipped. At entry use intended entry; target use current observed print.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: frozen_max_distance_points
rows.formula: ACTUAL maximum opposing-parent separation frozen at parent lock. Fixed 20 for MCB025; recorded rounded dynamic value for MCB062. Excluded from F0 deliberately.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: total_net_gamma
rows.formula: Exact signed aggregate vendor gex from latest eligible daily report at THIS decision. No recomputation by summing levels.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: positive_report_age
rows.formula: Count of DISTINCT eligible consecutive positive reports from the saved as-of policy; zero on known nonpositive report; unknown stays null. Do not count carried calendar rows.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: gamma_state
rows.formula: negative if gex<0; zero if =0; early_positive if >0 and report age 1..5; established_positive if age>=6; unknown if unavailable.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: hvl_distance_r
rows.formula: (Current decision price - eligible HVL price)/r.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: nearest_upper_distance_r
rows.formula: (Nearest gamma-bearing eligible EOD level price >= current price - current price)/r; only finite prices and nonnull gex; all saved named levels eligible.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: nearest_upper_gex
rows.formula: Signed gex at the above selected level. Equal-price ties use lexical name, frozen; no largest-gex tie selection.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: nearest_lower_distance_r
rows.formula: (Current price - nearest gamma-bearing eligible EOD level price <= current price)/r; same universe and lexical tie-break.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: nearest_lower_gex
rows.formula: Signed gex at the below selected level, not a claim about actual dealer orders.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: gamma_report_age_hours
rows.formula: Elapsed UTC hours since selected daily gamma nominal eligibility time. Null if none eligible.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

rows.name: level_set_age_hours
rows.formula: Elapsed UTC hours since selected level set nominal eligibility time. Null if none eligible.
rows.missing_policy: null plus explicit reason; never outcome-informed substitution

scope_notes: Entry geometry stays frozen; clock/current market/vendor features are sampled at the job's own decision.
Every source carries actual known-at time and value provenance. Only availability<=decision is usable.
F0 excludes frozen dynamic allowance, vendor range, vendor status/age, raw study/account/event IDs, and expected-move-normalized proxies.
MCB062's opportunity population already depends on expected movement; F0 is no additional vendor model inputs, not a vendor-free trading strategy.
All features must be mapped or reproducibly derived from the EXACT owning strategy event; missing zones cannot be borrowed from a related configuration.
A wholly unavailable feature remains declared and flagged; no silent substitute or outcome-based feature search. Genuine data absence need not block other cells.
Source validity and availability booleans may be used only through explicit numeric missing flags and the declared fields. Raw IDs/dates/path strings are audit-only.
1D Min/Max null gex is legitimate and never replaced with zero.
No qscore, intraday snapshot expansion, news, MBP1 order-flow feature build, or inferred touch-history feature in this first study.
